label: The First Way's mover receives its esse in no principle and has no matter and form (inference)
rule: Reductio on reception under the simplicity reading's essence-esse clause
meaning: Let f be a first mover moved by none. The simplicity reading gives that f is not composed of matter and form and that its esse is not distinct from its essence. Suppose f's esse were received in a principle p. If its esse equalled its essence, identity-scoped reception (R3) would make p its essence and De ente's reading would put p in receptive potency to f's esse, that is to itself, against receptive irreflexivity; so its esse would be distinct from its essence, against simplicity. Constructive: no excluded middle.
